productionPathProof.fact: A live execution-tree update associates a context for a newly visible exact AgentRun.
That context starts with an empty conversation and AgentStatus.Offline.
Because the mounted view already has the exact task ID, click takes the local reuse branch.
focusTeamMemberAndEnsureHydrated only focuses the exact ID and patches navigation; it performs no projection fetch or hydration.
The row becomes current from navigation focusedAgentRunId, which explains the truthful current styling over the false-empty local context.

rootCause: Frontend live-created task contexts are materialized as default Offline/empty shells. Selecting a shell in an already-mounted Team takes a function named ensure hydrated that only focuses and patches navigation. It does not request or merge the exact retained projection. Therefore exact row/view identity can be correct while the monitor data is false-empty. Full/fresh hydration requests the exact projection and masks the defect.
boundaryConclusion: Frontend defect. Node 8001 already serves distinct exact task data. The result does not depend on whether the assignee later calls submit_task_result, and no backend prompt, tool, lifecycle, or persistence change is justified.
